title: Check motor vehicle stamp duty
summary: Find out about stamp duty costs when transferring a new or used vehicle into your name.
intro:
When you buy a new or used vehicle you may be required to pay stamp duty costs when you transfer the vehicle into your name. Stamp duty is calculated on the market value of the vehicle or the purchase price, whichever is higher.

If you'd like to calculate the stamp duty for a vehicle, you can do this online using Revenue NSW's stamp duty calculator.
what_you_need: The market value or purchase price of the vehicle (whichever is higher).

more_info.text: Stamp duty is calculated at $3 per $100, or part thereof, of the vehicle's value.
